title: Otitis Media (Acute or Chronic)
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS
EAR, NOSE AND THROAT/HEAD AND NECK DISEASES

blocks.text: It is an inflammation of the middle ear cavity. It is considered acute when the inflammation is of less than 2 weeks’ duration, and chronic when the inflammation is of more than 2 weeks’ duration with tympanic membrane perforation.

runs.text: It is an inflammation of the middle ear cavity. It is considered acute when the inflammation is of less than 2 weeks’ duration, and chronic when the inflammation is of more than 2 weeks’ duration with tympanic membrane perforation.

blocks.text: Using an otoscope carefully examine the external auditory canal and the tympanic membrane
